settings.heading: We'll put it right.
settings.subheading: A claim is how you tell us something is wrong with an order, so we can put it right.

settings.title: Submit claim
settings.text: Your order number and photos, on WhatsApp, by phone or by email.

settings.title: More information if needed
settings.text: If needed, we ask for more photos or for the pair back.

settings.title: Decision
settings.text: We tell you whether the claim is accepted.

settings.title: Resolution
settings.text: We replace the pair, or refund it if no replacement is available.

settings.title: Wrong product
settings.body: Tell us within 48 hours of delivery if the pair is not the one you ordered.

settings.title: Transit damage
settings.body: Tell us within 48 hours of delivery if the pair arrives damaged. If a parcel is lost or damaged by the courier, we take it up with the courier ourselves; you do not have to.

settings.title: Missing item
settings.body: Tell us within 48 hours of delivery if an item is missing.

settings.title: Stitching defects
settings.body: If stitching opens in normal wear within 30 days of delivery, send photos.

settings.title: Sole separation
settings.body: If a sole separates in normal wear within 30 days of delivery, send photos.

settings.title: How to submit
settings.body: Send your order number, clear photos of the pair, the box and the courier label, and your unboxing video if you have one, on WhatsApp, by phone at +92 319 9628735 or by email to contact@daursupply.com. A video helps but is not required.

settings.title: Review and resolution
settings.body: We check the photos and, if needed, ask for the pair back. When the claim is accepted we replace the pair, or refund it if no replacement is available.
settings.dev_note: How long a review usually takes, and how many days a refund takes.

settings.title: Exclusions
settings.body: Normal wear, scuffs, water damage, misuse, and claims made after the time limits above.
